summary_method: Arithmetic means of two per-run summaries with reversed/balanced execution order, not pooled percentiles or an overall desktop-speed score. Every comparison uses its own identical harness on both images.
limitations: Synthetic unpaced server planning/FIFO/codec/protocol output to a discard socket. No capture, RDP transport, browser paint, Wi-Fi or physical input. Fixed codec mode bypasses automatic classification; observations add the same clock/statistics cost to both images. Diagnostic-on records have additional candidate instrumentation and are separate from default-off performance summaries.
encoding_caveat: Automatic full-wallpaper reverse baseline selects PNG while candidate remains WebP. Exclude its automatic total-cost result from equal-quality claims. Non-wallpaper auto realized codec calls/pixels/payloads/quality match; lossy auto quality is 90. Fixed WebP75 and PNG comparisons require equal realized payload work. Production codec/quality policy remains unchanged.
selection: Portable -O2 is the primary improvement. Optimized-control bitmap B/A/A/B 60 results reduce scrolling/redraw p95 about6–7% with equal planner work; retained bitmap costs 8192 bytes. One late-copy order-sensitive tail was investigated with a 180-sample reversed balanced follow-up. No codec hysteresis is introduced without evidence.
